evaluations.rationale: Strong source coverage and consistent character visuals with locked traits restated on re-entry; minor pacing drag from extended V.O. blocks in illness and garden scenes.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add an explicit rule that no V.O. block may exceed two sentences without an intervening one-line visual or sound micro-beat.

evaluations.rationale: Covers core beats but compresses summer and illness sections too aggressively, with inconsistent re-description of Rabbit's appearance across time jumps.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add a rule requiring every character re-entry after a time jump to restate two to three locked visual traits in the first action line of that scene.

disqualifyingIssues: Screenplay is truncated mid-sentence and does not complete the story arc
evaluations.rationale: Incomplete draft drops the fairy transformation, final spring scene, and resolution; fidelity penalized severely for missing major beats.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add a rule that the final scene must always include a short closing beat returning to any established on-camera frame before FADE OUT.

disqualifyingIssues: Invented on-camera NARRATOR frame and study location not present in source
evaluations.rationale: Major invented plot element (framing narrator in study) violates fidelity; otherwise solid visuals but disqualified for added content.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add an explicit prohibition against inventing any on-camera frame narrator or new locations unless they appear in the source text.

evaluations.rationale: Good visual consistency and closed cast but introduces invented spoken lines such as 'You're the best present of all' that paraphrase rather than preserve book wording.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add a rule that any summarized exchange receives at most one brief generic period-appropriate line and never invented character-specific dialogue.

evaluations.rationale: Exceptional fidelity with precise book wording, consistent locked visuals restated on re-entry, concrete filmable actions, and balanced sound cues in every scene.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add a rule requiring at least one explicit (SOUND: ...) or (MUSIC: ...) cue in every scene, with two distinct cues at any emotional peak.

evaluations.rationale: Very strong coverage and character consistency with named wild rabbits kept stable; slightly slower pacing in illness sequence due to longer action paragraphs.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add a rule that action lines must describe only one concrete camera-observable event per line and never cram multiple distinct actions into a single paragraph.

judgeSummaryNotes: Strongest: Screenplay F because it achieves the highest scores across all dimensions with no invented content and perfectly balanced short-clip-ready structure. Weakest: Screenplay C because it is truncated mid-sentence and fails to deliver a complete arc.
